headline: Martin Shkreli Says New Photonic Chips Could Run Circles Around Nvidia
summary: Martin Shkreli just named three private startups he believes could threaten Nvidia's dominance in AI chips, and his reasoning involves a technology that computes at the speed of light. The catch is that Nvidia may already be one step ahead.

headline: Corning: Not Worth The AI Risk (Rating Downgrade)
summary: Corning is downgraded to Sell from Hold due to high valuation, aggressive growth assumptions, and a relatively weaker technological edge. Read more on GLW.
